import numpy as np
y=dP_dt
knots=np.linspace(0.5,12,12)
def hat(x):
    H=np.zeros((len(x),len(knots)))
    for j in range(len(knots)):
        left=knots[j-1] if j>0 else -np.inf
        right=knots[j+1] if j<len(knots)-1 else np.inf
        k=knots[j]
        up=(x-left)/(k-left) if j>0 else np.ones_like(x)
        dn=(right-x)/(right-k) if j<len(knots)-1 else np.ones_like(x)
        H[:,j]=np.clip(np.minimum(up,dn),0,1)
    return H
